candidates.statement: Payment service latency is elevated (p95 1600ms) with payment.authorize spans erroring at 1350ms and 9 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings; gateway's call to payment errors at 1967ms, propagating checkout errors and latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment's own downstream dependency causing the deadline is not identified; no payment dependency spans or db_pool_waiters/dependency_timeouts detail beyond zero counters.

report.explanation: Payment shows the only anomalous latency (p95 1600ms vs 70ms elsewhere), erroring authorize spans, and 504 deadline-exceeded logs; gateway's payment call errors at ~2s. Gateway/order/inventory metrics are healthy and deployment record is old and valid, so no other cause is supported.
